items.context: @BSCGemsAlert (460.480 seguidores), en inglés: "BULL MARKET STARTS NEXT WEEK?!" Afirma que los mercados bajistas de 2014, 2018 y 2022 duraron 58 semanas (406 días) y que 2026 llega a la misma marca, con imagen. Post de ~23 min con 25 likes, 2 respuestas y 4161 vistas. Ángulo: caídas y días de recuperación por ciclo (Cycle Clock y Drawdown Atlas).
items.suggested_text:
The symmetry is striking, but it's worth separating two clocks that often get mixed up: peak to trough, and trough back to the old high.

Even if the trough lands on schedule, the second clock has been far less regular. After 2011 Bitcoin fell 92.7% and took 622 days to reclaim its high; after 2013 it fell 84.5% and needed 1,177. Within 2013 itself, one peak was recovered in 210 days and the other in 1,177.

So a bottom forming on time and a bull market starting next week aren't quite the same claim. Four data points make a pattern, but they also make a very small sample, and the market has a habit of punishing whatever everyone is counting the days to.
